Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Algustas wrote:
>
> Hi Scott,
> I am preparing to host a V:TES tourney at a game con, and I noticed that
> Rotschreck is no longer on the banned list. I haven't looked at the banned
> list for a year (since last years tourney), but I was under the impression
> it was a banned card. Could you confirm for me one way or the other?

It is not on the banned list.
The banned list consists only of:

* Ante cards.
* Paralyze cards
* Monocle of Clarity

Note that the URL for the DCI rules has moved (to a new subdirectory):

http://www.wizards.com/Leagues_and_Tournaments/DCI/VTES_Rules.html
